SELECT bul.store_code AS groupKey, bul.store_code AS groupLabel, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalConfirmCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 2 THEN bul.benefit_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalConfirmAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalReturnCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 3 THEN bul.benefit_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalReturnAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalLockCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rr.reconcile_status IN (2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalRetryCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rr.reconcile_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS matchedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rr.reconcile_status IN (2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unmatchedCount FROM t_reconcile_record rr INNER JOIN t_benefit_use_log bul ON rr.use_no = bul.use_no AND bul.is_deleted = 0 WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY bul.store_code

SELECT bul.pos_code AS groupKey, bul.pos_code AS groupLabel, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalConfirmCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 2 THEN bul.benefit_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalConfirmAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalReturnCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 3 THEN bul.benefit_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalReturnAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalLockCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rr.reconcile_status IN (2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalRetryCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rr.reconcile_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS matchedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rr.reconcile_status IN (2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unmatchedCount FROM t_reconcile_record rr INNER JOIN t_benefit_use_log bul ON rr.use_no = bul.use_no AND bul.is_deleted = 0 WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY bul.pos_code

SELECT CAST(rr.reconcile_date AS CHAR) AS groupKey, CAST(rr.reconcile_date AS CHAR) AS groupLabel, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalConfirmCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 2 THEN bul.benefit_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalConfirmAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalReturnCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 3 THEN bul.benefit_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalReturnAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bul.use_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalLockCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rr.reconcile_status IN (2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalRetryCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rr.reconcile_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS matchedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rr.reconcile_status IN (2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unmatchedCount FROM t_reconcile_record rr INNER JOIN t_benefit_use_log bul ON rr.use_no = bul.use_no AND bul.is_deleted = 0 WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY rr.reconcile_date ORDER BY rr.reconcile_date
